notes.title: How these are counted
notes.kast: KAST is the share of rounds played in which the player got a kill or an assist, survived, or had their death traded.
notes.trade: A trade is an opponent kill within {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of a teammate's death.
notes.multi: 2K to 5K count the rounds with exactly that many opponent kills.
notes.flash: A flash assist is a teammate's kill on an opponent whose blindness from your flash was still running; your own kills do not count.
notes.rating: Rating 1.0 is HLTV's published formula; later versions are not public and are not approximated.
notes.opening: An opening duel is the first kill of a round. Opening success is the share of the opening duels a player took part in that they won.

setNotes.main: Select a player to open their details.
setNotes.duels: An opening duel is the round's first kill.
setNotes.multi: Rounds with exactly 2, 3, 4 or 5 opponent kills.
setNotes.utility: Health damage to opponents with HE grenades, molotovs and incendiaries.

detail.keyRounds: Key rounds — open in the replay

notes.thrown: Grenades thrown are counted inside the rounds, whether or not they went off, and shown per round played. Team rows are per team round.
notes.flashes: Enemies per flash is the opponents blinded divided by the flashbangs thrown, flashes that blinded nobody included. Average enemy blind is the mean blind time per opponent blinded. A team flash blinds a teammate; blinding yourself does not count.
notes.damage: Utility damage is the health damage dealt to opponents with HE grenades, molotovs and incendiaries.
notes.unused: Unused at death is the shop price of the grenades a player was holding when they died: HE 300, flash 200, smoke 300, decoy 50, molotov 400 for a T and incendiary 500 for a CT. It is read from the last 16 Hz sample before the death, and a defuse kit is not counted.

utility.noFlashEvents: This recording carries no flash events, so enemies per flash, average enemy blind, team flashes and flash assists cannot be shown.

stats.noFlashEvents: This recording carries no flash events, so flash assists and enemy blind time cannot be shown.

fig.firstKillConceded: Won after conceding the first kill

notes.pistol: Pistol rounds are round 1 and round 13; overtime has none.
notes.buy: A team's buy is the one more than half of its players made: eco, force (force or semi-buy) or full. Rounds where no buy has a majority are left out of all three.
notes.antiEco: An anti-eco round is a team's full buy against an opposing eco; the figure is how many of those it lost.
notes.firstKill: The first kill is the round's first opponent kill. Rounds without one are left out.
notes.manAdvantage: 5v4 and 4v5 are read after the round's first death, from five players a side; rounds that cannot say are left out.
notes.bomb: Plants are counted over T rounds, post-plant wins over T rounds with a plant, retakes over CT rounds facing one. Totals only: there is no split by site yet.
notes.split: Each figure is split by the side played in that round; a dash means there were no rounds to measure, not zero.
